decision.explanation: All three answers are supported by direct quotes from the provided sources. Document d1 explicitly states that Henry Gilbert was a citizen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, citing historical records and expert testimony. Document d2 claims he held dual citizenship of the United Kingdom and Iran. Since these are distinct legal entities and the sources do not resolve the contradiction, all valid referents are preserved.
